hooks.name: Check spec consistency when requirements change
hooks.description: When a spec's requirements.md is saved, checks that its design.md and tasks.md still cover every acceptance criterion. Reports gaps; doesn't edit.

action.prompt: A spec's requirements.md was just saved. Read it together with the design.md and tasks.md in the same folder. List (1) acceptance criteria that no task's _Requirements:_ line references, (2) task or property references to requirement numbers that no longer exist, and (3) design decisions that contradict a changed requirement. Report only; don't edit any files. If everything lines up, reply with one line saying so.
